Tooltip_morphine: Instantly restores health, kills all pain and clears the mind, but does not heal wounds. Highly addictive.
Tooltip_naloxone: An opioid antagonist. Eases addiction, but leaves you hungry and parched.
Tooltip_fentanyl: A potent synthetic opioid. Instantly restores health, soothes all wounds, kills all pain and clears the mind. Extremely addictive.
Tooltip_oxycontin: A mild opioid painkiller. Restores some health and takes the edge off. Somewhat addictive.
